name: Shy
overview: Scripture encourages those who feel shy or fearful to trust in God's presence and strength, as He promises to uphold and help His people (Isaiah 41:10). Believers are called to bring their concerns to God through prayer and thanksgiving, finding peace instead of anxiety (Philippians 4:6). The gospel assures that faith in Christ grants eternal life, offering confidence beyond earthly fears (John 3:16). Ultimately, God's revelation to His servants reveals His sovereign plan, encouraging believers to stand firm despite personal insecurities (Revelation 1:1).
